title: Guidance rule ledger v1
description: One row per guidance rule: the hypothesis it was written for, the replay or executable cases that stand for the failures it prevents, and the date it was last reviewed. `repo compare --ledger` pairs each rule's cases against its arm and a baseline and reports a verdict (keep, review or insufficient-evidence). Only the verdict is computed; cutting a rule is a human decision. Ids are unique within the file (checked by the loader, which JSON Schema cannot express).

policy.description: Optional. alpha: the Holm-adjusted p below which a delta counts. review_within_days: a review older than this is flagged as stale.

id.description: Stable across edits of the guidance, unique in the file.

source.description: Where the rule lives or was mined from: a file and anchor, or a review comment URL.

hypothesis.description: What the rule should change in an agent's answer on its cases.

arm.description: The treatment arm that carries the rule, ARM or BATCH/ARM.

baseline.description: Optional baseline arm for this rule; default: the --baseline of the compare.

cases.description: Task ids of the cases that stand for the failures the rule prevents.

reviewed.description: The date (YYYY-MM-DD) a maintainer last confirmed the rule still earns its place.
